findings.text: blocking: Equality of boundary winding and admitted index sum cannot certify that every critical point was found: an omitted extremum (+1) and saddle (-1) cancel, so read_state:595 can accept a zero-saddle field as limited despite a missed saddle; test_coverage.py:83-118 exercises only one missed saddle.

blocking: The table and 5/12 headline use pre-certificate labels for slices 0 and 14, while receipts/tcv-liuqe-coverage-rows.jsonl records both as coverage uncertified; that receipt has only two rows, so the revised decision was not measured across the twelve reported slices.

blocking: The comparison table omits the paired LIUQE and nova X-point positions and both boundary flux values, giving only their gaps, and omits the explicit axis-psi gap; the source done_when requires paired values and absolute and relative gaps per slice.

follow-on: read_wall duplicates the IMAS limiter-unit extraction owned by nova/equilibrium/wall_mask.py:209-220 instead of extending or wrapping that owner; this copy also bypasses its single-description and unit validation.

follow-on: The only real LIUQE slice assertion is marked slow and excluded by the recorded gate, and its branch accepts either a certified limited read or an uncertified refusal, so the gate cannot detect loss of actual limited-slice coverage.
